Title: Small language models are moving onto your phone

URL Source: https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/11/15/1120044/small-language-models-on-device/

Published Time: 2026-11-15T15:00:00Z

Markdown Content:
Phone makers are now shipping language models with about three billion parameters that run entirely on the device. Apple, Google and Samsung each announced on-device assistants this autumn that summarize notifications, draft replies and translate speech without a network connection.

Developers say the shift changes which features need a server. "Anything that touches personal data is moving local first," said one engineer. Battery life remains the constraint: running the model continuously drains a phone in about four hours.

Researchers expect quantized 7-billion-parameter models on flagship phones by late 2027.
